a.lede: Citrix has confirmed that two critical NetScaler remote code execution vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks and that it has released security updates to fix the flaws. [...]
a.title: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks

b.lede: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered U.S. government agencies over the weekend to secure their systems against attacks exploiting two critical Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities. [...]
b.title: CISA orders feds to patch exploited Citrix flaws by Wednesday
